bmw.summary: BMW's four-cylinder superbike is designed around high-performance road and circuit riding. Its story is one of evolving aerodynamics, electronics and chassis technology.
bmw.years: Model introduced for 2009. Key generations include the original 2009–2014 family, substantial 2015 revision, 2019 redesign and later updates. Exact variant years require individual verification.
sections: Design and purpose

The S 1000 RR has always combined a relatively compact sports riding position with a powerful inline-four engine. The original asymmetrical headlamp arrangement gave it a distinctive identity; newer generations adopted more symmetrical styling and integrated aerodynamic features.
Engine and performance

BMW's ShiftCam variable valve timing arrived with the redesigned 2019 generation. That change should never be described as applying to all earlier S 1000 RR motorcycles. Peak power, gearing and electronic rider aids differ across model years.
Generations matter

A 2012 S 1000 RR and a modern M Sport are not interchangeable in a buying comparison. Equipment, frame details, electronics, brakes and even the engine design have changed. Buyers should identify the actual model year before comparing specifications.
Buying considerations

Check recorded service history, originality, maintenance of track-used examples and the specification of optional packages. Verify the exact model and variant against manufacturer records rather than relying only on the registration date.

generation_milestones.change: Original S 1000 RR model family
Redesigned generation including BMW ShiftCam
Revised engine, 210 hp EU specification
Aerodynamic revisions and updated electronic equipment

honda.summary: Honda's Africa Twin family combines adventure-bike ergonomics with a long rally-inspired heritage. Modern models emphasise mixed-surface travel and the choice of a manual gearbox or Honda DCT.
honda.years: Modern CRF1000L: 2016–2019. Successor CRF1100L: introduced for 2020, with later updates and Adventure Sports variants. Older XRV Africa Twin generations have their own production history.
sections: Why the Africa Twin exists

The name connects modern adventure motorcycles with Honda's earlier Paris–Dakar era. Long-travel suspension, upright control and practical equipment are central to the model's intended uses, although the road-versus-trail balance differs by variant.
Manual or DCT?

Honda's Dual Clutch Transmission is a geared transmission with automated clutch control and shifts. It is not the same as a scooter CVT. DCT availability depends on generation and specification, and both versions deserve separate consideration.
From 1000 to 1100
The CRF1100L introduced for 2020 is a distinct generation, with a larger-capacity parallel twin and updated equipment. A used CRF1000L should not be presented with CRF1100L figures or technology.
Who might choose one?

Riders planning mixed road conditions may value the upright position and adventure-focused equipment. Touring riders should also compare screen protection, luggage, seat height and the Adventure Sports specification.

generation_milestones.change: Modern Africa Twin model launched

ducati.summary: The Panigale V4 brought Ducati's V4 superbike design into its production flagship. Each revision has combined distinctive Italian styling with track-oriented engineering.
ducati.years: Panigale V4 introduced for the 2018 model year. Major updates followed, including significant 2022 and 2025-model developments. Confirm production and equipment dates for each individual variant.
sections: Design shaped by speed

The Panigale V4's narrow waist, sculpted fairing and racing-oriented riding position serve both styling and performance. Aero packages and winglet designs have evolved, so photographs of one generation cannot verify equipment on another.
The V4 engine

Ducati's Desmosedici Stradale is derived from its V4 racing-engine philosophy. The Panigale V4's cylinder layout, power delivery and engine character differ from Ducati's earlier V-twin Panigale superbikes.
Electronics and chassis
Cornering ABS, traction control, engine-brake management and suspension specifications vary between model years and V4/V4 S versions. Comparisons should name a precise variant and year.
Buying a used Panigale
Consider the model-specific maintenance schedule, track use, tyre and brake condition, available electronic packages and service documentation. Verify specialist service requirements before purchase.

generation_milestones.change: Substantial revisions to aero, ergonomics, engine, chassis and electronics
New redesigned Panigale V4, unveiled July 2024

bmw-r1300gs.summary: The R 1300 GS combines BMW's boxer-engine adventure-bike heritage with a redesigned 1,300 cc engine, road-touring comfort and equipment for mixed-surface journeys.
bmw-r1300gs.years: R 1300 GS introduced for the 2024 model year. Individual equipment and transmission choices depend on market and build specification.

generation_milestones.change: BMW announced its next-generation R 1300 GS
Introduction of the redesigned R 1300 GS platform with 1,300 cc boxer power

sections: Character and design

The R 1300 GS is a versatile travel enduro rather than a single-purpose off-road machine. Its distinctive boxer layout, upright riding position and adventure equipment are designed to balance long-distance road riding with occasional unsealed routes.
The 1300-generation boxer
BMW's 1,300 cc boxer delivers 145 hp and 149 Nm in the published model-family technical data. These figures should not be applied to older R 1200 GS or R 1250 GS generations.
Transmission and equipment

BMW offers R 1300 GS-family configurations with an automated shift assistant. Check whether an individual motorcycle has a conventional manual setup or the optional automated-shift system before comparing examples.
What to check when sourcing

Compare the exact model year, specification and luggage or suspension equipment. Buyers should confirm service records, accessory fitment and the condition appropriate to the intended touring or mixed-surface use.

bmw-m1000rr.summary: BMW's M 1000 RR is a motorsport-oriented superbike developed from the S 1000 RR platform, with distinctive aerodynamic and circuit-focused engineering.
bmw-m1000rr.years: BMW documented this model in 2020. The complete production-year range and generation variations are still being checked.

generation_milestones.change: Updated aerodynamics, carbon-fibre bodywork and refined racing-focused equipment
BMW premiered the first M 1000 RR in September 2020

sections: Built for performance
The M 1000 RR is not merely an S 1000 RR with a different badge. BMW developed it with motorsport-focused engine, aerodynamic and chassis equipment.
The 2023 update
BMW described changes to aerodynamic downforce and carbon-fibre bodywork for the 2023 model year, including revisions to the front and rear sections.
Engine specification
BMW confirms 212 hp and 113 Nm for the 2023 road-going M 1000 RR in its manufacturer support information. These figures should not be confused with output from modified racing machines.
Buying considerations

Confirm the exact M specification, optional equipment, service history and any signs of extensive track use. Original components and documented maintenance can matter significantly to a specialist buyer.

bmw-r1250gs.summary: BMW's R 1250 GS pairs long-distance adventure-bike ergonomics with a 1,254 cc boxer twin and ShiftCam variable valve timing.
bmw-r1250gs.years: The R 1250 GS entered European markets in October 2018. Verify the individual model year, equipment and production date before comparing examples.

generation_milestones.change: R 1250 generation launched in European markets with ShiftCam variable intake valve timing
BMW announced the new ShiftCam-equipped R 1250 GS
Reference specification and generation documented by BMW

sections: Boxer engine and ShiftCam
BMW's ShiftCam varies intake valve timing and lift. Its 1,254 cc boxer should not be confused with the preceding R 1200 GS or the subsequent R 1300 GS.
GS and GS Adventure
The standard GS and GS Adventure offer different touring equipment and fuel capacity. Compare the actual trim, luggage and suspension rather than treating both motorcycles as identical.
Adventure touring
The upright riding position, boxer engine and protective bodywork suit extensive road travel and occasional mixed-surface routes.
Sourcing checks
Confirm electronic suspension, rider aids, luggage, service records and whether recalls or software work have been completed.

bmw-s1000xr.summary: The S 1000 XR combines BMW's high-revving four-cylinder sports-bike engineering with an upright touring position and practical road-going equipment.
bmw-s1000xr.years: The updated S 1000 XR revealed in October 2023 uses the 170 hp 999 cc specification. Earlier generations and versions differ.

generation_milestones.change: Reference specification and generation documented by BMW

sections: Sport performance with touring practicality
The four-cylinder engine delivers a different character from BMW's boxer GS range. Upright ergonomics and luggage options make it suitable for long road journeys.
Updated engine specification
BMW's October 2023 technical release quotes 170 hp at 11,000 rpm and 114 Nm at 9,250 rpm for its refreshed XR. Earlier examples do not all share those figures.
Comfort and technology
Depending on the version, compare the seat, suspension, touring equipment and optional lightweight wheels. Equipment packs alter the character and value of individual motorcycles.
Sourcing checks
Look for good service records, condition of the chain and brakes, and evidence of careful maintenance of the electronic equipment and optional accessories.

bmw-r1250rt.summary: The BMW R 1250 RT is a fully faired long-distance touring motorcycle, built around a 1,254 cc boxer twin and extensive weather protection.
bmw-r1250rt.years: The R 1250 RT entered European markets in October 2018. Verify the individual model year, equipment and production date before comparing examples.

generation_milestones.change: R 1250 generation launched in European markets with ShiftCam variable intake valve timing
Reference specification and generation documented by BMW

sections: Purpose-built touring
The RT emphasises weather protection, luggage and passenger comfort rather than the mixed-surface capabilities of a GS.
Boxer touring engine
BMW describes a 1,254 cc boxer producing 136 hp and 143 Nm. The engine's torque-oriented delivery suits two-up touring and sustained road journeys.
Cockpit and equipment
Some R 1250 RT versions feature a 10.25-inch TFT display and integrated navigation functions. Confirm equipment and actual model year rather than assuming every bike matches the latest version.
Sourcing checks
Check pannier operation, touring electronics, service history, screen adjustment and any evidence of low-speed drops or heavily loaded long-distance use.

bmw-k1600gt.summary: BMW's K 1600 GT is a premium performance tourer distinguished by its smooth 1,649 cc inline six-cylinder engine.
bmw-k1600gt.years: BMW's current UK technical listing quotes 160 hp and 180 Nm. Earlier K 1600 generations can have different torque figures and equipment.

generation_milestones.change: Reference specification and generation documented by BMW
BMW presented the new six-cylinder K 1600 GT at Intermot

sections: Six-cylinder character
The K 1600 GT's inline-six is designed for smooth power delivery and strong overtaking performance while carrying rider, passenger and luggage.
Later-generation powertrain
BMW's published specification lists a 1,649 cc engine producing 160 hp and 180 Nm. Earlier K 1600 versions should be assessed using year-specific data.
Touring equipment
Wind protection, integrated luggage, electronic suspension and cockpit features are central to the GT experience. GT and GTL have distinct seating and touring priorities.
Sourcing checks
Assess electronic functions, luggage condition, service records, tyre wear and the cost of maintaining an extensively equipped six-cylinder touring motorcycle.

bmw-f900gs.summary: The F 900 GS is BMW's lighter, off-road-oriented middleweight adventure model, powered by a 895 cc parallel twin.
bmw-f900gs.years: Figures shown are from the BMW F 900 GS technical sheet. Do not apply them to the earlier F 850 GS.

generation_milestones.change: BMW announced the new F 900 GS adventure model

sections: Trail-biased design
The F 900 GS pairs an upright adventure riding position with a 21-inch front wheel and long suspension travel, making it more trail-oriented than BMW's road-biased XR models.
Engine and gearing
BMW quotes 105 hp and 93 Nm from the 895 cc parallel twin. A six-speed manual transmission and chain final drive distinguish its operating character from the large boxer GS machines.
Equipment differences
The GS, GS Adventure and different equipment packages are not equivalent. Tank size, rider aids and suspension specification should be checked for each individual bike.
Before sourcing
Check off-road wear on wheels, rims, frame protection and suspension, as well as the completeness of service records and factory equipment.

bmw-f900r.summary: The BMW F 900 R is a middleweight naked roadster with an 895 cc parallel-twin engine and sporty everyday-road ergonomics.
bmw-f900r.years: Announced in November 2019 and described in BMW's 2020 US launch information. Later engine figures and specifications must be compared separately by year and market.

generation_milestones.change: F 900 R and F 900 XR introduced as a new middleweight roadster and sport-adventure pair
BMW announced the F 900 R roadster

sections: Everyday roadster
The F 900 R's upright riding position and compact naked design favour city journeys and winding roads rather than extensive weather-protected touring.
Parallel-twin performance
BMW's published technical specification lists 105 hp and 92 Nm. Restricted variants differ and must be identified separately.
R versus XR
The F 900 R is the unfaired roadster in BMW's middleweight range. The F 900 XR offers a different seating and touring proposition.
Buying considerations
Confirm specification, service records, tyre condition and the presence of factory electronic options. Check whether the motorcycle is restricted for licence eligibility.

bmw-k1600gtl.summary: BMW's K 1600 GTL is its comfort-oriented six-cylinder luxury tourer, designed especially for extended two-up road travel.
bmw-k1600gtl.years: Published UK technical information for the revised K 1600 GTL quotes 160 hp and 180 Nm. Older versions differ.

generation_milestones.change: BMW presented the new six-cylinder K 1600 GTL at Intermot

sections: Luxury touring purpose
The GTL favours relaxed long-distance ergonomics, substantial weather protection and generous luggage provision for rider and passenger.
Inline-six engine
The 1,649 cc six-cylinder engine develops 160 hp and 180 Nm in BMW's published current-generation specification, with a six-speed gearbox and shaft final drive.
GT versus GTL
Although mechanically related, the K 1600 GT and GTL differ in their emphasis on posture, passenger comfort and luggage. They should be compared as separate variants.
Inspection priorities
Test the luggage locks, electronic controls, suspension functions and touring equipment. Confirm maintenance records and budget for the running costs of a heavy premium tourer.

bmw-f900xr.summary: The BMW F 900 XR is a road-focused middleweight sports-tourer with a relaxed upright position, wind protection and an 895 cc parallel twin.
bmw-f900xr.years: Announced in November 2019 and described in BMW's 2020 US launch information. Later engine figures and specifications must be compared separately by year and market.

generation_milestones.change: F 900 R and F 900 XR introduced as a new middleweight roadster and sport-adventure pair
BMW announced the F 900 XR sports tourer

sections: Sport touring character
The XR combines the accessible seating position of an upright motorcycle with road-biased wheels and fairing protection for longer journeys.
Engine and transmission
The 895 cc twin is rated at 105 hp and 93 Nm in BMW's UK technical data, driving the rear wheel via a six-speed gearbox and chain.
Equipment differences
The precise year and equipment package determine whether features such as Dynamic ESA, cruise control, centre stand or luggage mounts are fitted.
Choosing a used example
Check maintenance records, chain and sprockets, suspension, accident damage and completeness of luggage and electronic equipment.

bmw-r18.summary: The BMW R 18 is a heritage cruiser centred on a large air/oil-cooled 1,802 cc boxer engine, exposed shaft drive and traditional styling.
bmw-r18.years: These specifications refer to BMW's R 18 2024 model technical documentation; other years and derivatives may differ.

generation_milestones.change: R 18 world premiere and First Edition launch

sections: The Big Boxer
The 1,802 cc boxer makes the R 18 notably different from BMW's GS and RT touring engines. Its published figures are 91 hp and 158 Nm.
Heritage identity
Exposed shaft drive, low cruiser proportions and extensive metal detailing give the R 18 its distinctive character.
Understanding the R 18 family
The base R 18, Classic and other touring or cruiser derivatives have distinct equipment and ergonomics. Check the precise version.
Buying considerations
Inspect brightwork, accessories, service history, heavy-bike handling marks and condition of the shaft drive and braking components.

bmw-ce04.summary: The BMW CE 04 is an electric urban scooter with a low, elongated silhouette, automatic single-speed drive and city-focused technology.
bmw-ce04.years: BMW documents this model in 2022. Exact production and registration dates, variants and country-specific specifications should be checked for each motorcycle.

generation_milestones.change: CE 04 included in BMW's 2022 US lineup

sections: Electric city mobility

The CE 04 is built for short to medium urban trips rather than conventional long-distance motorcycle touring. Its distinctive architecture provides a different riding position from petrol-powered BMW scooters.
Charging and daily use

Real-world range and charging time depend on riding conditions, temperature, charging equipment and the exact model specification. Buyers should confirm how the bike can be charged at home or at work.
Electric drivetrain
The CE 04 uses electric propulsion rather than a petrol engine or a scooter continuously variable transmission. Instant torque and single-speed operation give it a distinctive riding character.
Sourcing checks
Examine battery health information, charging equipment, service history, software updates and completeness of keys and accessories.

bmw-rninet.summary: BMW's R nineT is a retro-styled boxer roadster whose exposed engineering and classic proportions make customisation and riding character central to its appeal.
bmw-rninet.years: Specifications, equipment and production versions vary by year. When requesting one, give AnyBike the preferred production year and exact model variant.

generation_milestones.change: Series production of the R nineT began in Berlin

sections: Modern classic design
The R nineT brings together a traditional-looking fuel tank, circular headlamp and boxer engine with modern brakes and electronic equipment.
Boxer roadster
Its opposed-cylinder layout provides an unmistakable visual and mechanical character, different from BMW's parallel-twin F series or four-cylinder S series.
Family differences
R nineT, R nineT Pure, Scrambler and other derivatives vary in suspension, wheels, ergonomics and styling. The name alone does not establish the precise equipment specification.
Choosing a used example
Check maintenance history, the quality of modifications, corrosion, suspension condition and retention of original parts if collectability matters.

bmw-f850gs.summary: The F 850 GS is BMW's middleweight adventure motorcycle, balancing road touring with occasional trails through a parallel-twin engine and upright ergonomics.
bmw-f850gs.years: Specifications, equipment and production versions vary by year. When requesting one, give AnyBike the preferred production year and exact model variant.

generation_milestones.change: Fully redesigned F 850 GS announced

sections: Middleweight adventure role
The F 850 GS sits below the big boxer GS machines in BMW's adventure family, with different weight distribution, drivetrain and running costs.
Road and trail priorities
Depending on equipment, longer-travel suspension, spoke wheels and rider modes can make it suitable for mixed-surface journeys while retaining comfortable road manners.
GS and Adventure versions
The F 850 GS and F 850 GS Adventure do not have identical fuel tanks, wind protection or touring equipment. Match the description to the actual bike.
Sourcing checks
Check the chain, wheels, suspension, service history, engine protection and signs of demanding off-road use.

bmw-s1000r.summary: The BMW S 1000 R is an upright naked sports motorcycle drawing on S 1000 RR four-cylinder engineering but with its own ergonomics, styling and road-riding character.
bmw-s1000r.years: Specifications, equipment and production versions vary by year. When requesting one, give AnyBike the preferred production year and exact model variant.

generation_milestones.change: BMW announced the original S 1000 R roadster

sections: Superbike-derived roadster
The S 1000 R uses high-performance four-cylinder engineering in a more upright package than the fully faired S 1000 RR.
Street-riding priorities
The absence of a large fairing and the upright bars change the experience at road speeds; it should not be described as an RR with identical performance specifications.
Generation differences
Engine tuning, frame, rider aids and styling have changed across the S 1000 R model family. Compare the exact model year rather than carrying specifications across generations.
Sourcing checks
Inspect service records, tyres, brakes, electronic rider aids and the condition of any aftermarket exhaust or other modifications.

bmw-r1250r.summary: A boxer-powered BMW roadster built around flexible road performance, a relatively upright riding position and the character of the 1250-generation engine.
bmw-r1250r.years: BMW announcement evidence begins in 2018. Exact production and registration dates, variants and country-specific specifications should be checked for each motorcycle.

generation_milestones.change: New R 1250 R announced with ShiftCam boxer engine

sections: Unfaired boxer design
The R 1250 R offers a distinct roadster alternative to the larger, more weather-protected R 1250 RT. Its low fairing coverage and exposed boxer cylinders are part of its identity.
Engine character
The 1250-generation boxer uses BMW ShiftCam technology. Equipment and precise configuration depend on the model year and market.
Compared with the GS
The R 1250 R has road-oriented ergonomics and wheels rather than the GS family's adventure stance, ground clearance and touring options.
What to inspect
Check service history, suspension adjustment, electronic options, shaft-drive condition and any signs of accident repair.

bmw-c400gt.summary: BMW's C 400 GT is a mid-capacity petrol scooter focused on city commuting and longer everyday journeys with more wind protection than a minimalist urban scooter.
bmw-c400gt.years: BMW announcement evidence begins in 2018. Exact production and registration dates, variants and country-specific specifications should be checked for each motorcycle.

generation_milestones.change: C 400 GT introduced as comfort-oriented alternative to C 400 X

sections: Urban touring design
A protective front fairing, comfortable seating and storage place practicality ahead of sports-bike performance.
Automatic scooter drive
The C 400 GT uses a scooter-style automatic drivetrain, unlike BMW's conventional geared motorcycles or its electric CE range.
GT and X versions
The C 400 GT and C 400 X have different styling and priorities. Details such as screen protection, seating and equipment should be checked against the specific example.
Before buying
Check service records, belt and transmission maintenance, electronic equipment, brakes and bodywork condition from everyday urban use.

bmw-ce02.summary: The BMW CE 02 is a compact electric urban two-wheeler with unconventional styling, easy single-speed operation and a focus on short journeys.
bmw-ce02.years: BMW announcement evidence begins in 2023. Exact production and registration dates, variants and country-specific specifications should be checked for each motorcycle.

generation_milestones.change: BMW announced the CE 02 and its two power variants

official_colours.name: Granite Grey Metallic Matt
official_colours.details: Motor cover with black frame and wheels

sections: A different kind of BMW
The CE 02 sits apart from BMW's petrol roadsters and touring motorcycles, with a low compact design aimed primarily at urban transport.
Electric operation
Charging compatibility, available range and riding performance depend on exact battery and motor specification. Different versions may suit different licence classes.
City-friendly layout
Its small dimensions and simplified electric transmission make it a practical proposition for local travel rather than long-distance touring.
Sourcing considerations
Confirm battery configuration, charger, keys, service history and market-specific homologation before evaluating an imported example.

bmw-r1200gs.summary: The R 1200 GS is a major earlier generation of BMW's boxer adventure range, widely associated with long-distance travel and all-round road capability.
bmw-r1200gs.years: BMW documents this model in 2004. Exact production and registration dates, variants and country-specific specifications should be checked for each motorcycle.

generation_milestones.change: BMW confirms new R 1200 GS introduced in 2004

sections: A long-running model name
The R 1200 GS name spans multiple engineering revisions; early and later versions should not be grouped under a single technical specification.
Air-cooled and liquid-cooled eras
BMW developed the R 1200 GS substantially across its lifespan, including a later liquid-cooled generation. Engine configuration, electronics and chassis equipment differ.
GS and Adventure
The GS Adventure is a distinct travel-oriented derivative; fuel capacity, weather protection and fitted equipment need individual confirmation.
Used-bike priorities
Review service records, shaft drive, suspension, electronics, corrosion and signs of heavy touring or off-road use, paying particular attention to the exact generation.

bmw-c-400-x.summary: Urban mid-capacity BMW scooter with an automatic transmission and compact bodywork aimed at commuting and everyday trips.
bmw-c-400-x.years: BMW announcement evidence begins in 2017. Exact production and registration dates, variants and country-specific specifications should be checked for each motorcycle.

generation_milestones.change: BMW confirms C 400 X was first presented in autumn 2017

sections: Urban scooter character
The C 400 X is designed for routine city use and shorter trips rather than the long-distance touring role of BMW's RT and K series.
Automatic operation
Its scooter drivetrain differs from the manual gearboxes of most BMW motorcycles and from the electric drive of the CE range.
X or GT?
The C 400 X and C 400 GT share a family relationship but differ in styling, wind protection and touring emphasis.
Used scooter checks
Inspect the bodywork, maintenance record, belt and transmission servicing, brakes, tyres and electronic convenience equipment.

bmw-g-650-gs.summary: Single-cylinder BMW adventure motorcycle valued for its relatively simple layout, manageable dimensions and versatile road-and-trail purpose.
bmw-g-650-gs.years: BMW documented this model in 2010. The complete production-year range and generation variations are still being checked.

generation_milestones.change: BMW released the new G 650 GS press kit in October 2010

sections: Single-cylinder GS
The G 650 GS occupies a different place in BMW's history from the larger boxer GS machines and later parallel-twin models.
Everyday versatility
Upright ergonomics and relatively modest bulk make it interesting to riders seeking mixed road conditions without a large touring motorcycle.
Version differences
Some variants use different wheels, suspension configurations and seat heights; check the precise build and model year.
Buying considerations
Look for documented maintenance, condition of chain and sprockets, cooling system, wheels and corrosion-prone components.

bmw-hp4.summary: Special high-performance BMW superbike derived from the S 1000 RR, with performance-oriented chassis, brakes and specialist equipment.
bmw-hp4.years: Specifications, equipment and production versions vary by year. When requesting one, give AnyBike the preferred production year and exact model variant.

generation_milestones.change: HP4 unveiled, rated 193 hp

sections: What the HP4 name represents
BMW has used the HP4 name for high-performance motorcycles closely related to its superbike engineering. It is not interchangeable with an ordinary S 1000 RR trim description.
Technology and development
Premium components, electronics and weight-saving equipment made HP4 variants distinctive. The HP4 Race is a separate, more specialised track-focused machine.
Rare-model provenance
Exact version, originality and provenance matter because the appeal and service needs of specialist superbikes can differ widely.
Inspection priorities
Check model identification, service records, track-use history and the authenticity and condition of expensive original components.

bmw-r-1200-rt.summary: BMW boxer-powered touring motorcycle with extensive weather protection and a long history of technical and equipment changes.
bmw-r-1200-rt.years: Specifications, equipment and production versions vary by year. When requesting one, give AnyBike the preferred production year and exact model variant.

generation_milestones.change: BMW introduced a new liquid-cooled R 1200 RT generation

sections: Purpose-built road touring
The RT combines a fairing, protective screen and luggage capabilities with BMW's boxer-engine character.
Generations must be separated
R 1200 RT models span different engine and chassis developments. A single horsepower or electronics specification would be misleading across the whole nameplate.
Touring equipment
Screen adjustment, luggage, heated equipment and suspension configuration can vary considerably between years.
Choosing a used RT
Check maintenance, shaft-drive operation, touring electronics, luggage condition and whether the exact version has relevant documented service work.

bmw-r-32.summary: BMW's first production motorcycle, historically significant for establishing the company's boxer-engine and shaft-drive motorcycle layout.
bmw-r-32.years: BMW Group Classic records production from 1923 to 1926.

generation_milestones.change: BMW's first production motorcycle unveiled at the Berlin Motor Show

sections: A landmark first model
Introduced in 1923, the R 32 established a core BMW motorcycle identity: a transverse boxer twin with shaft final drive.
Early engineering
The air-cooled flat twin and shaft drive differed from many chain-driven motorcycles of the period, making the R 32 a foundational design.
Historic context
This is a collector's motorcycle rather than a modern road machine; original mechanical design and surviving documentation should determine how it is described.
Collector considerations
Authenticity, provenance, restoration quality and specialist parts support matter more than modern equipment comparisons.

bmw-r-80-g-s.summary: Historic BMW boxer dual-purpose motorcycle associated with the origins of the modern large-capacity adventure-bike category.
bmw-r-80-g-s.years: Produced from 1980 to 1987 according to BMW Group Classic. Specifications below refer to the original historic model.

generation_milestones.change: Historic model introduced

sections: The early G/S concept
Introduced in 1980, the R 80 G/S brought road-touring boxer characteristics to a purpose-built dual-use motorcycle.
Adventure heritage
Its long-travel suspension and upright layout influenced later BMW GS motorcycles, although it should not be credited with modern GS equipment.
Classic specifications
Historic production changes and special editions require specialist confirmation before publishing model-year-specific specifications.
Buying a classic G/S
Confirm frame and engine numbers with marque experts, examine restoration provenance and assess condition of the shaft drive, suspension and original equipment.

bmw-r-90-s.summary: Classic BMW boxer sports-tourer renowned for 1970s styling, distinctive fairing and place in the company's sporting history.
bmw-r-90-s.years: Produced from 1973 to 1976 according to BMW Group Classic. Specifications below refer to the original historic model.

generation_milestones.change: Historic model introduced

sections: BMW's 1970s sporting image
The R 90 S introduced in 1973 is closely associated with BMW's transition toward a more overtly sporting road-bike identity.
Distinctive equipment
A small cockpit fairing and two-tone paint schemes are among the recognisable features of the R 90 S; originality can matter strongly to collectors.
Mechanical era
The air-cooled boxer and period chassis should be assessed on their own merits rather than compared by modern roadster specifications.
Historic-bike checks
Inspect provenance, original equipment, mechanical restoration, documentation and any period-correct modifications.
